definitions.explanation: A fixed sequence of actions or activities performed regularly. Used for daily habits, work procedures, and athletic warm-up patterns.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ルーチン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こなす→こなす：09897_konasu⟧。
⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ルーチン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{効率|こうりつ}→効率：11794_kouritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Once you establish a work routine, efficiency goes up.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{試合前|しあいまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧ルーチン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: That athlete is known for always performing the same routine before a game.

notes:
USAGE:
ルーチン comes from English "routine" and is widely used in Japanese. It became especially popular through the concept of ルーティン (variant spelling) in sports and self-improvement contexts. Both spellings are common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ルーチン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こなす→こなす：09897_konasu⟧ (to go through a routine)
- ルーチン⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to make something into a routine)
- ルーチンワーク (routine work)
- ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ルーチン / ⟦モーニング→モーニング：27084_mooningu⟧ルーチン (morning routine)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ルーチン / ルーティン: routine (both spellings are used)
- ⟦{日課|にっか}→日課：00317_nikka⟧: daily task/routine (native Japanese word)
- ⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧: habit
